decision.rationale: Prior working family was AR1 as provisional predictor. With staggered fd0dad93 and left-pulse abd2d3f5 added for improved excitation and channel separation, AR2 now shows better fit (0.121 vs 0.127C) and better whole-trial LOO validation (0.946 vs 0.992C), supporting revision to AR2 as predictive structure only, not mechanistic cause. Budget exhausted so submit; remaining ambiguity in cross-trial generalization would have needed further excitation.
